name: Chili Con Carne
description: A hearty and versatile chili recipe featuring ground beef, kidney beans, and a variety of vegetables, ideal for customization.
recipeIngredient: Optional: additional vegetables like zucchini, carrots, mushrooms

recipeInstructions.text: In a large nonstick skillet, cook ground beef over medium-high heat until browned and crumbly; drain off excess fat.
Add onion and garlic to the skillet and cook for 5 minutes.
Add cabbage, celery, green pepper, tomatoes with juice, tomato sauce, kidney beans, chili powder, oregano, salt, and hot pepper sauce to the skillet.
Optionally add other desired vegetables (e.g., zucchini, carrots, mushrooms) at this stage.
Cover and simmer over medium heat for 45 minutes, or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.

keywords: chili con carne, ground beef chili, customizable chili

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Beef Porcupines
_similar.description: Baked meatballs with rice, served in a tangy tomato-based sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix ground beef, rice, onion, mustard, chili powder, salt, allspice, brown sugar, pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and paprika. Form into balls.
Place meatballs in a baking dish.
Combine tomato soup and hot water to make the sauce. Pour over meatballs.
Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked

_similar.name: Noodles with Hamburg
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground hamburger, macaroni, and a blend of vegetables and cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: In a frying pan, brown the hamburger with celery and onions (if using). Drain excess fat.
Add garlic powder, oregano, salt, tomato soup, corn, and canned tomatoes to the browned hamburger mixture. Stir to combine.
Simmer the mixture slowly for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Cook macaroni according to package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Combine the cooked macaroni with the hamburger and sauce mixture. Stir well.
If using cheese, heat it until melted and mix into the noodle and hamburger mixture.
Serve hot.

_similar.keywords: hamburger casserole, noodle dish, comfort food

_similar.name: Shepherd's Pie
_similar.description: A classic shepherd's pie made with ground beef, mixed vegetables, and topped with mashed potatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef in an electric skillet. Drain excess fat.
Add onion soup mix, frozen vegetables, beef cube, salt, and pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes.
Pour the mixture into a 6-cup (1.5 L) casserole dish or square baking dish.
Top with mashed potatoes and sprinkle with paprika if desired.
Bake at 400°F for 15 to 20 minutes, until the potatoes are firm and golden brown.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: shepherd's pie, ground beef, mashed potatoes, casserole
